title: Tree traversals
description:
Build a small tree and print it in every order.

```
      F
    B   G
   A D    I
    C E  H
pre:   F B A D C E G I H
in:    A B C D E F G H I
post:  A C E D B H I G F
level: F B G A D I C E H
```
hints: Pre-order prints the node, then the left, then the right; in-order puts the node in the middle (lesson 4.01).
A small helper `std::unique_ptr<Node> leaf(char c)` makes building the tree shorter.
requirements: `struct Node { char value; std::unique_ptr<Node> left, right; };`
Recursive pre-, in- and post-order; level order with a `std::queue`.
stretch: Print the height and the number of leaves.
